structured.reason: The description contains a hedge that the strict criterion treats as a negative signal: "By clearing the top layer of dead skin, it can help your favorite skincare products absorb more effectively." The modal "can help" softens the performance claim into a conditional, similar to the "may"/"can sometimes" hedges the criterion explicitly disallows. The rest of the copy is pure positive or neutral factual (materials, compact size, non-slip handle, protective cover, price, CTA), and no complaint from the reviews is addressed directly. Under the instruction to lean toward failing when unsure, the hedge is enough to fail.
